name: Shadowlands Circle Necromancy
description: The necromancy of the First Circle, binding the dark energies of the Underworld — potent but limited in scope. Invoking this Charm enables the character to cast a single Shadowlands Circle Necromancy spell; the spell's own Essence cost (listed in its description) must also be paid. Shadowlands Circle Necromancy can never be part of a Combo. Ghost-Blooded may learn this initiation but no greater circle (PG p.48); the initiation requires Essence 3 and Occult 5 and costs 10 bonus points or 25 experience. ⚠ the Occult 5 reading is the PG's generic 'Terrestrial initiation' requirement applied to the necromancy path — confirm with the rules authority.
